boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Siena spaces documented as settings for studying, gathering, programs, reflection, dining, and recreation.

cards.entity_name: J. Spencer and Patricia Standish Library
cards.title: Standish Library study rooms
cards.subtitle: Academic Quad
cards.notes: Reserve a library room when your group needs a whiteboard and space to spread out; Siena specifically identifies its rooms as available for reservation.
cards.short_summary: A reservable setting for focused group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena states that the library has rooms available for reservation, and student accounts describe study rooms with whiteboards for group study.
cards.source_title: What Saints Love About Siena's Library
cards.access_notes: Library rooms are available for reservation; confirm availability through the library.

cards.title: Million Dollar View
cards.subtitle: Main level, Standish Library
cards.notes: Use the main-level couches for a collaborative reading break or low-key project discussion; the library’s feature identifies this named window-area seating.
cards.short_summary: Named library seating that looks over the baseball field.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies the Million Dollar View on Standish Library's main level as couch seating used for group work and overlooking the baseball field.
cards.source_title: What Saints Love About Siena's Library
cards.access_notes: Located inside Standish Library; follow library access rules.

cards.title: Sarazen Student Union
cards.subtitle: Campus student-services hub
cards.notes: Check the Student Activities calendar before heading over for weekend programming such as trivia, crafts, and other campus events.
cards.short_summary: The building Siena names as the setting for recurring student programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says its weekend Siena Night Life programs take place in the Sarazen Student Union and include trivia nights, craft nights, and off-campus activities.
cards.access_notes: Event availability varies; consult Student Activities for current programs.

cards.title: Casey's Lounge
cards.subtitle: Sarazen Student Union
cards.notes: Use Casey’s as a daytime meet-up point for food or coursework, then check current Union programming if you want an evening activity.
cards.short_summary: A Union spot students have described using for food, studying, and campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: In Siena's student-voice feature, students describe Casey's as a place for breakfast, coffee, studying, meals, karaoke, and trivia.
cards.source_title: My favorite spot on Siena's campus is...
cards.access_notes: Located in the Sarazen Student Union; dining and event availability may vary.

cards.title: Maloney Great Room
cards.subtitle: SSU 240, Sarazen Student Union
cards.notes: Watch Siena’s event listings for talks and recognition programs held here; the 2026 leadership awards ceremony is scheduled in this room.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Union event room for lectures and community recognition.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena lists the Maloney Great Room (SSU 240) as the site of its April 30, 2026 Student Leadership & Involvement Awards Ceremony.
cards.access_notes: Use is event-based; check the sponsoring office for attendance details.

cards.title: Nigro Family Plaza
cards.subtitle: Academic Quad entrance to Sarazen Student Union
cards.notes: Pause by the Contrade flags, then use the plaza as a campus wayfinding point before entering the Student Union from the Academic Quad.
cards.short_summary: A flag-framed plaza that hosts a first-year orientation tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says the 17 Contrade symbols frame Nigro Family Plaza and that new students gather there on the first night of Orientation.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus plaza; follow event setup and campus-access guidance.

cards.title: Lonnstrom Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Main campus dining facility
cards.notes: Plan a meal or a short catch-up here, and verify your meal-plan or payment option before ordering; Siena identifies it as the main dining facility.
cards.short_summary: Siena’s main dining hall and a documented setting for student gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes Lonnstrom Dining Hall as its main dining facility and says it gives students a place to gather and meet friends.
cards.source_title: Siena College Rededicates Dining Hall to Celebrate Lonnstrom Legacy
cards.access_notes: Dining requires an applicable meal plan or other payment method.

cards.title: The Grotto
cards.subtitle: Near Padua Road
cards.notes: Take a quiet pause among the memorial and Franciscan statues; treat the site as a contemplative space and keep conversations respectful.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus shrine for prayer, contemplation, healing, and peace.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes the Grotto as a sacred space for prayer, contemplation, healing, and peace, with memorial and Franciscan statues.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sacred space; respect its reflective purpose.

cards.entity_name: St. Mary of the Angels Chapel
cards.title: St. Mary of the Angels Chapel
cards.subtitle: Siena campus
cards.notes: Visit for quiet prayer or a scheduled liturgy, and check the Chaplain’s Office page for the current service schedule before attending.
cards.short_summary: The chapel at the center of Siena’s Chaplain’s Office programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies St. Mary of the Angels Chapel as a spiritual home and states that students are invited to worship at liturgies and participate in faith-formation programs.
cards.access_notes: Services and access vary by schedule; the Chaplain’s Office lists current offerings.

cards.title: Marcelle Athletic Complex
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Bring your Siena ID and use the complex for a workout, pool time, indoor track, or club and intramural activities as available.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation complex with multiple active-use spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says students can work out, join aerobics, swim, use the indoor track, and take part in club and intramural sports at the MAC.
cards.access_notes: Bring required campus identification and confirm facility availability before visiting.
